admission: Inherit that exact GLB1 byte/JSON/accessor/static-pose/selected-scene/PNG integrity and consumer budget validation unchanged; no JPEG/other extensions or external resources. New role-specific identity does not widen old profile admission.
geometry: Use all validated static triangle primitive occurrences in original(nodeIndex,primitiveIndex,triangleIndex) order, transformed by their source node matrices. No flattening ambiguity, decimation, generated proxy or name-based association.
contentFacts: Empty materials array, complete original meshTriangle ranges and inherited geometry bounds. Interaction-only family uses first-verified-output envelope authority. Imported proxy has derivedFrom empty and no invented derivation tool; source bytes/relation are explicit, not inferred provenance.
appearance: Authored GLB materials/textures remain original validated bytes but have no interaction coverage/sidedness authority. Interaction triangles are two-sided geometry; do not apply alpha/chroma, create a MaterialCatalog or include source appearance in a visual pass.
frame: The user explicitly confirms that this file is prepared in the selected GS Asset's coordinate system and unit. Initial representationToAsset is canonical identity; unknown registration is refused, never inferred by bounds, filename, overlap or an independent Mesh.
bounds: Inherited exact static geometry AABB after the explicit representationToAsset transform; retained for validation/interaction acceleration only, never visual fit bounds

records.proxyForGsVariantFamilyId: explicit visual GS family in the same AssetRevision

visibility: Never contributes to color, depth, shadow, screenshot, material controls, model list membership, visual fit or measurement. Only the explicitly selected visible GS family can admit its unique verified same-Asset proxy.
anchor: Transient approximate hit transforms to GS AssetFrame; ordinary gizmo adjustment or explicit confirmation writes a source-less, normal-less, confidence-less manual anchor with active GS class/revision. Save/reopen never raycasts this proxy.
